docs.title: Simple expense tracking. Free forever.
docs.text: Track your money in and out without the complexity of traditional finance apps. No subscriptions, no ads, no account required.

docs.title: What It Does
docs.text:
Money In & Out helps you answer one simple question: Where is my money going?

  • Add transactions - Manually or by scanning receipts
  • Organize with categories - See spending patterns
  • View analysis - Charts and breakdowns by day, week, month, or year
  • Sync across devices - iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud

That's it. No budgeting, no bank connections, no bill reminders. Just straightforward expense tracking.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• AI Receipt Scanner - Snap a photo, auto-fill details instantly
  • Quick Entry - Add transactions in seconds
  • Smart Categories - Color-coded organization
  • Visual Analysis - Charts and spending breakdowns
  • iCloud Sync - Seamless across all Apple devices
  • 100% Private - Your data never leaves your devices
  • Works Offline - No internet required

docs.title: ✅ Perfect if you want to:
docs.text:
• Track daily expenses simply
  • Know where your money goes
  • Scan receipts and auto-fill details
  • Keep your financial data private
  • Use across iPhone, iPad, and Mac

docs.title: ❌ Not for you if you need:
docs.text:
• Bank account connections
  • Budgeting and forecasting tools
  • Bill reminders and alerts
  • Investment tracking
  • Loan calculators
  • Multi-user/family sharing

docs.title: What Makes It Different?
docs.text:
Privacy First - All AI processing happens on your device. Your receipts and transactions never touch our servers or any cloud AI service.

Truly Free - No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads. Free forever.

Simple by Design - We intentionally keep it simple. One thing done well beats ten things done poorly.

docs.title: Is this app right for me?
docs.text:
You'll love Money In & Out if you: - Want simple expense tracking without complexity - Value privacy and want data to stay on your devices - Like scanning receipts to auto-fill details - Use iPhone, iPad, or Mac (or all three) - Want a free app with no ads or subscriptions

Look elsewhere if you need: - Bank account connections - Budgeting and forecasting tools - Bill reminders and alerts - Investment tracking - Multi-user or family sharing

docs.title: Is Money In & Out really free?
docs.text: Yes, completely free. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads. Free forever.

docs.title: Why is it free?
docs.text: We built Money In & Out because we wanted a simple expense tracker for ourselves. We're sharing it with others who want the same thing.

docs.title: Will you add a paid version?
docs.text: No plans for that. The app will remain free.

docs.title: What platforms does it support?
docs.text:

  • Mac (macOS 26.0+)

docs.title: Do I need an account?
docs.text: No account required. Just download and use.

docs.title: What data do you collect?
docs.text: None. We don't collect any data about you or your transactions.

docs.title: Where is my data stored?
docs.text: On your device and optionally in your iCloud account (if you enable sync).

docs.title: Can you see my transactions?
docs.text: No. We have no access to your data. It's stored locally on your devices and in your private iCloud account.

docs.title: Is my data encrypted?
docs.text: Yes. iCloud data is encrypted end-to-end. Local data is protected by your device security.

docs.title: Can I export my data?
docs.text: Yes. Export to CSV format anytime from the app.

docs.title: Can I set budgets?
docs.text: Not currently. Money In & Out focuses on tracking, not budgeting.

docs.title: Are there recurring transactions?
docs.text: Not yet. You need to add recurring transactions manually each time.

docs.title: Can I attach receipts?
docs.text: Yes! The receipt scanner automatically saves receipt images with transactions. You can also manually attach photos to any transaction.

docs.title: Is there a web version?
docs.text: No. Money In & Out is Apple platforms only.

docs.title: Can I connect my bank?
docs.text: No. Money In & Out doesn't connect to banks. Manual entry only.

docs.title: Can I share with family?
docs.text: Not directly. Each person needs their own copy. Family sharing of the app is supported through App Store.

docs.title: How does the receipt scanner work?
docs.text: Snap a photo → AI extracts merchant, amount, date → Review and save. Takes 2-3 seconds, works offline. Full receipt scanner guide →

docs.title: Why is the app 1.02 GB?
docs.text: We include a complete AI model (Qwen3 1.7B) inside the app for 100% privacy - your receipts never leave your device.

docs.title: Is my receipt data private?
docs.text: Yes. All processing happens on your device. No cloud AI services, no uploads, works offline.

docs.title: How accurate is the scanner?
docs.text: 85-95% accurate. Always review auto-filled fields before saving - you can edit anything.

docs.title: What if I don't want to use the scanner?
docs.text: Manual entry is always available and takes ~5 seconds.

docs.title: Is iCloud sync required?
docs.text: No, it's optional. iCloud sync is ON by default if you have iCloud Drive enabled, but you can turn it off in Settings if you prefer to keep data local only. The app works fine either way.

docs.title: Does sync cost money?
docs.text: No. iCloud sync is free with your Apple ID. Money In & Out uses minimal storage and is automatically enabled if you have iCloud Drive turned on.

docs.title: How fast is sync?
docs.text: Usually within seconds. Depends on your internet connection.

docs.title: What if I have sync issues?
docs.text: Check that: - iCloud Drive is enabled - You're signed in with same Apple ID on all devices - You have internet connection - Money In & Out is enabled in iCloud settings

docs.title: Can I sync with Android?
docs.text: No. iCloud sync only works with Apple devices.

docs.title: How do I add a transaction?
docs.text: Two ways: 1. Scan Receipt: Tap +, choose "Scan Receipt", take photo, review auto-filled details, save 2. Manual Entry: Tap +, choose "Manual Entry", enter details, save

docs.title: Can I edit transactions?
docs.text: Yes. Tap any transaction to edit it.

docs.title: Can I delete transactions?
docs.text: Yes. Swipe left on a transaction and tap Delete.

docs.title: How do I create categories?
docs.text: Go to Categories section, tap Add Category, enter details, save.

docs.title: Can I change category colors?
docs.text: Yes, when creating or editing a category.

docs.title: How do I see spending by category?
docs.text: Go to the Analysis tab to see charts and breakdowns.

docs.title: What iOS version do I need?
docs.text: iOS 26.0+ for iPhone/iPad, macOS 26.0+ for Mac.

docs.title: How much storage does it use?
docs.text: Very little. Typically less than 10 MB even with years of data.

docs.title: Does it work offline?
docs.text: Yes. Add transactions offline, they'll sync when you're back online.

docs.title: Can I use on multiple devices?
docs.text: Yes. Enable iCloud sync to use on all your Apple devices.

docs.title: What if I get a new device?
docs.text: Install the app, sign in with your Apple ID, enable iCloud sync. Your data will download automatically.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Money In & Out is committed to protecting your privacy. This app is designed with privacy as a core principle - no ads, no tracking, no data collection.

docs.title: Data Collection
docs.text: We do not collect any personal data. All information you enter into Money In & Out remains on your device and is never transmitted to our servers or any third-party services.

docs.title: What We Don't Collect
docs.text:
• No personal information
  • No transaction details
  • No receipt images
  • No usage analytics
  • No crash reports
  • No device information
  • No location data
  • Nothing. Zero. Nada.

docs.title: Receipt Scanner & On-Device AI
docs.text: Money In & Out includes a receipt scanner powered by on-device AI:

docs.title: How It Works
docs.text:
• Receipt images are processed entirely on your device using Apple's Vision framework
  • Text extraction uses optical character recognition (OCR) running locally
  • Smart parsing uses Apple Intelligence (Foundation Models) when available
  • All AI models run on your device - nothing is sent to the cloud
  • Receipt images are stored locally with your transactions

docs.title: Your Privacy
docs.text:
• No receipt images are uploaded to any server
  • No transaction data is sent externally
  • All processing happens on-device
  • Receipt images sync via your iCloud (if enabled) - never through our servers
  • You can delete receipt images anytime

docs.title: On-Device AI Model
docs.text: Money In & Out includes a complete AI language model (Qwen3 1.7B, 4-bit quantized): - Bundled inside the app (~1 GB) - Runs entirely on your device - No data sent to Apple or any external service - No internet connection required - Completely private and secure

docs.title: Local Storage
docs.text:
• All transaction and category data is stored locally on your device using SwiftData
  • Receipt images are stored locally with transactions
  • Data is stored in your device's secure storage area
  • No data is accessible to other apps or services
  • Protected by your device's security features (passcode, Face ID, Touch ID)

docs.title: Your Control
docs.text:

  • Delete any transaction anytime
  • Delete any category anytime
  • Uninstall the app to remove all local data

docs.text: iCloud sync is completely optional. You can use Money In & Out without ever enabling it.

docs.text:
If you choose to enable iCloud sync:

  • Your data synchronizes across your Apple devices using Apple's CloudKit service

  • We do not have access to your iCloud data
  • Only you can access your data

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Welcome to Money In & Out - simple expense tracking that respects your privacy and time.

docs.title: What is Money In & Out?
docs.text:
Money In & Out is a straightforward expense tracker for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It helps you track income and expenses without the complexity of traditional finance apps.

Core Philosophy: - Simple - No complicated setup or learning curve - Fast - Add transactions in seconds - Private - Your data stays on your devices - Free - No subscriptions, no ads, no hidden costs

docs.title: 1. Add Transactions
docs.text:
Two ways to add:

Scan Receipt (Fastest) 1. Tap the + button 2. Take a photo of your receipt 3. AI extracts merchant, amount, and date 4. Review and save

Manual Entry 1. Tap the + button 2. Enter amount and select category 3. Save

docs.title: 2. Smart Categories
docs.text:
The AI automatically organizes transactions into categories: - Auto-matching - Recognizes merchants and assigns categories - Auto-creation - Creates new categories when needed - Smart learning - Remembers your preferences

Categories like Food & Dining, Transportation, Shopping, Entertainment, and more are created automatically based on your spending.

Each category has a color and icon for quick identification.

docs.title: 3. View Analysis
docs.text: See your spending patterns: - By period - Day, week, month, or year - By category - Visual charts and breakdowns - Summary stats - Total income, expenses, net balance

docs.title: 4. Sync Across Devices
docs.text: Enable iCloud sync to keep data synchronized across: - iPhone and iPad (iOS 26.0+) - Mac (macOS 26.0+)

docs.text: Snap a photo, AI extracts merchant, amount, and date in 2-3 seconds. All processing on-device for 100% privacy. Full guide →

  • ❌ No budgeting features
  • ❌ No bill reminders

  • ❌ No loan calculators

flowchart TD
    A[Scan Receipt or Add Transaction] --> B{Merchant Recognized?}
    B -->|Yes| C{Category Exists?}
    B -->|No| D[Analyze Transaction Details]

    C -->|Yes| E[Assign Existing Category]
    C -->|No| F[Create New Category]

    D --> G{Similar Category Exists?}
    G -->|Yes| E
    G -->|No| F

    E --> H[Transaction Saved]

    I --> H

    H --> J[Future Transactions<br/>Use This Mapping]

    style A fill:#7FE8D3
    style H fill:#F4A460

How it works:

  1. Merchant Recognition - AI identifies the merchant from receipt or transaction
  2. Category Matching - Checks if a matching category already exists
  3. Smart Creation - Creates a new category if needed (e.g., "Starbucks" → "Coffee")
  4. Learning - Remembers the merchant-to-category association
  5. Future Use - Next time you visit the same merchant, category is auto-assigned

Example: Scan a Starbucks receipt → AI creates "Coffee" category → Future Starbucks receipts automatically use "Coffee"

docs.title: Receipt Scanner
docs.text: The fastest way to add expenses - just snap a photo and let AI do the work.

docs.title: What It Does
docs.text:
The receipt scanner automatically extracts transaction details from receipt photos:

  • Merchant name - Where you spent money
  • Amount - How much you spent
  • Date - When the transaction occurred

All processing happens on your device - no internet required, completely private.

docs.title: Scanning a Receipt
docs.text:
1. Tap the + button in the app
  2. Choose "Scan Receipt"
  3. Take a photo of your receipt (or select from photos)
  4. Ensure receipt is well-lit and in focus
  5. Lay receipt flat on a surface
  6. Capture the entire receipt
  7. Wait 2-3 seconds for AI processing
  8. Review auto-filled details
  9. Merchant name
  10. Amount
  11. Date
  12. Edit if needed - You have full control
  13. Tap Save

The receipt image is saved with the transaction for your records.

docs.title: Tips for Best Results
docs.text:
• Good lighting - Natural light or bright indoor lighting
  • Flat surface - Lay receipt flat, avoid wrinkles
  • Clear photo - Hold steady, ensure text is readable
  • Full receipt - Capture entire receipt in frame
  • Avoid glare - Watch for reflections on glossy receipts

docs.title: AI Processing Pipeline
docs.text:
flowchart LR
    A[📸 Receipt Photo] --> B[Vision OCR<br/>~1 sec]
    B --> C[Qwen3 1.7B AI<br/>~1-2 sec]
    C --> D[Merchant]
    C --> E[Amount]
    C --> F[Date]
    D --> G[Category Matching]
    G --> H[✅ Transaction Ready]
    E --> H
    F --> H

    style A fill:#7FE8D3
    style C fill:#5DD9C1
    style H fill:#F4A460

Three-Stage Process:

Stage 1: Text Extraction (~1 second) - Apple Vision framework (OCR) - Extracts all text from receipt image - Identifies text regions and layout

Stage 2: Smart Parsing (~1-2 seconds) - Qwen3 1.7B AI model analyzes text - Identifies merchant, amount, and date - Structures the data

Stage 3: Category Assignment (instant) - Matches merchant to existing category - Creates new category if needed - Learns association for future use

Total time: 2-3 seconds

docs.title: The AI Model
docs.text:
Money In & Out includes a complete AI language model:

  • Model: Qwen3 1.7B (4-bit quantized)
  • Size: ~1 GB
  • Location: Bundled inside the app
  • Processing: 100% on your device
  • Privacy: Zero data sent to cloud

This is why the app is 1.02 GB - we include the entire AI model to ensure your receipts never leave your device.

docs.title: Your Receipts Stay Private
docs.text:
• On-device processing - All AI runs locally on your device
  • No cloud uploads - Receipt images never sent to external servers
  • No internet required - Works completely offline
  • Local storage - Images stored on your device or in your iCloud
  • You control everything - Delete receipts anytime

docs.text:

  • ❌ Don't use cloud AI services (Google, OpenAI, etc.)

  • ❌ Don't share data with third parties
  • ❌ Don't collect any data whatsoever

Solutions: - Close other apps to free memory - Restart device if very slow - Older devices may be slower - Processing time varies by device

docs.title: Manual Entry Alternative
docs.text:
Don't want to use the scanner? No problem!

  • Choose "Manual Entry" instead of "Scan Receipt"
  • Enter amount and optional note
  • Category is automatically assigned based on merchant
  • Takes ~5 seconds
  • No photo required

Both methods work equally well - use whichever you prefer.

docs.title: System Requirements
docs.text:
• iOS 26.0+ or macOS 26.0+
  • ~1 GB storage for AI model
  • Camera access (for taking photos)
  • Photo library access (for selecting existing photos)

docs.title: Offline Capability
docs.text:
The receipt scanner works completely offline:

  • No internet connection required
  • All processing on-device
  • Perfect for travel or areas with poor connectivity
  • Sync happens later when online (if iCloud enabled)

docs.title: Performance
docs.text:
• Processing time: 2-3 seconds average
  • Memory usage: ~200-300 MB during scanning
  • Battery impact: Minimal (similar to taking a photo)
  • Storage: Receipt images compressed to ~100-500 KB each

docs.text: Feature Receipt Scanner Manual Entry Speed 2-3 seconds + review 5-10 seconds Accuracy 85-95% (with review) 100% (you enter it) Convenience Just take photo Type everything Receipt image Automatically saved Can add manually Best for Most transactions Quick entries, no receipt

docs.title: Managing Transactions
docs.text: Learn everything about creating, editing, and organizing your transactions.

docs.title: What is a Transaction?
docs.text: A transaction represents any money movement - either income (money in) or expense (money out).

docs.title: Transaction Components
docs.text:
Every transaction has:

  • Amount - How much money (required)
  • Type - Income or Expense (required)
  • Category - How to classify it (required)
  • Date - When it occurred (defaults to today)
  • Note - Additional details (optional)

docs.title: Scan Receipt (Fastest!)
docs.text:
The easiest way to add an expense:

  1. Tap the + button
  2. Choose "Scan Receipt"
  3. Take a photo of your receipt
  4. Wait 2-3 seconds for AI processing
  5. Review auto-filled details
  6. Tap Save

Key benefits: - Auto-fills merchant, amount, and date - Receipt image saved automatically - Works offline - no internet required - 100% private - all processing on your device

Learn more about receipt scanning →

docs.title: Manual Entry
docs.text:
For quick manual transactions:

  1. Tap the + button
  2. Choose "Manual Entry"
  3. Enter amount
  4. Select Income or Expense
  5. Choose category
  6. Tap Save

Time: ~5 seconds

docs.title: Detailed Add
docs.text:
For more information:

  1. Tap the + button
  2. Enter amount
  3. Select type
  4. Choose category
  5. Change date if needed
  6. Add a note
  7. Tap Save

docs.title: Tips for Quick Entry
docs.text:
• Use the number pad for fast amount entry
  • Default type is usually Expense (most common)
  • Default date is today
  • Notes are optional - skip if not needed

docs.title: Edit Details
docs.text:
To modify a transaction:

  1. Tap the transaction in your list
  2. Change any field:
  3. Amount
  4. Type
  5. Category
  6. Date
  7. Note
  8. Tap Save

docs.title: When to Edit
docs.text:
• Correct mistakes
  • Update incomplete information
  • Change category
  • Fix wrong amount

Edit Carefully

Editing changes the transaction permanently. There's no edit history.

docs.title: Swipe to Delete
docs.text:
Quick deletion:

  1. Swipe left on transaction
  2. Tap Delete button
  3. Confirm if prompted

docs.title: Delete from Details
docs.text:
Alternative method:

  1. Tap transaction to open
  2. Find Delete button
  3. Confirm deletion

Deletion is Permanent

Deleted transactions cannot be recovered. Double-check before deleting.

docs.title: Income
docs.text:
Money coming in:

  • Salary/wages
  • Freelance payments
  • Gifts received
  • Refunds
  • Investment returns
  • Other income

Display: Usually shown in green with + symbol

docs.title: Expense
docs.text:
Money going out:

  • Purchases
  • Bills
  • Services
  • Subscriptions
  • Gifts given
  • Other spending

Display: Usually shown in red with - symbol

docs.title: Viewing Transactions
docs.text:
Your transaction list shows:

  • Most recent at top (default)
  • Grouped by date
  • Color-coded by category
  • Type indicator (income/expense)

docs.title: Sorting Options
docs.text:
Sort transactions by:

  • Date (newest first)
  • Date (oldest first)
  • Amount (highest first)
  • Amount (lowest first)
  • Category

docs.title: Filtering
docs.text:
Filter to show only:

  • Specific category
  • Income only
  • Expenses only
  • Date range
  • Amount range

docs.title: Quick Search
docs.text:
Find transactions fast:

  1. Tap search icon
  2. Type search term
  3. Results appear instantly

docs.title: Search By
docs.text:
• Amount (exact or partial)
  • Note text
  • Category name
  • Date

docs.title: Search Tips
docs.text:
• Use partial matches
  • Search is case-insensitive
  • Clear search to see all transactions

docs.title: Select Multiple
docs.text:
To work with multiple transactions:

  1. Enter selection mode
  2. Tap transactions to select
  3. Choose action:
  4. Delete selected
  5. Change category
  6. Export selected

docs.title: When to Use Bulk
docs.text:
• Cleaning up old data
  • Recategorizing multiple items
  • Exporting specific transactions

docs.title: Viewing Saved Receipts
docs.text:
To view a receipt image:

  1. Tap transaction with receipt thumbnail
  2. Tap the receipt image to view full-screen
  3. Pinch to zoom
  4. Share or export if needed

docs.title: Managing Receipts
docs.text:
• Receipt images are compressed to save space (~100-500 KB each)
  • Sync via iCloud if enabled
  • Delete transaction to remove receipt
  • Export transactions to save receipts externally

Full receipt scanner guide →

docs.title: Timing
docs.text:
• Scan immediately - Best accuracy when receipt is fresh
  • Add immediately - Don't wait
  • Daily review - Check for missed items
  • Weekly cleanup - Fix any errors

docs.title: Accuracy
docs.text:
• Round if needed - $4.99 can be $5
  • Be consistent - Use same categories
  • Add context - Brief notes help later

docs.title: Organization
docs.text:
• Use categories - Don't skip this
  • Meaningful notes - Future you will thank you
  • Regular cleanup - Delete test entries

docs.title: Split Transactions
docs.text:
If you need to split one purchase:

  1. Add multiple transactions
  2. Use same note for reference
  3. Different categories for each part

Example: Grocery store trip - $50 - Food & Dining - "Groceries" - $15 - Household - "Cleaning supplies"

docs.title: Recurring Transactions
docs.text:
For regular expenses:

  1. Add transaction each time
  2. Use consistent note
  3. Same category each time

Future Feature

Recurring transaction automation may be added in future versions.

docs.title: Refunds
docs.text:
To record a refund:

Option 1: Delete original expense

Option 2: Add as income with note "Refund: [original purchase]"

Option 3: Edit original to reduce amount

Choose based on your preference.

docs.title: Transaction Not Saving
docs.text:
• Check all required fields are filled
  • Ensure amount is valid number
  • Try restarting the app

docs.title: Transaction Disappeared
docs.text:
• Check filters - might be hidden
  • Check date range
  • Check if accidentally deleted
  • Verify iCloud sync status

docs.title: Wrong Amount
docs.text:
• Edit the transaction
  • Or delete and re-add
  • Double-check number pad entry
